create_camera_specs: create a CameraSpecs object with name, resolution, transform, and focal length for a Mitsuba camera
load_json_cameras: load camera specifications from a JSON file using JSONCameraSpecsIO.load
write_json_cameras: write camera specifications to a JSON file using JSONCameraSpecsIO.write
load_colmap_cameras: load camera specifications from a Colmap sparse model directory using ColmapCameraSpecsIO.load
generate_mitsuba_dict: generate a Mitsuba perspective camera dictionary from a CameraSpecs object using to_dict
